title: CodeMaster tracker config (.codemaster/config.json)
description: Per-project selection of the backlog tracker provider and its settings.

tracker.description: Which provider implements the tracker verbs.

verify.description: The project's own green-check command, run by build (every loop) and ship (final gate) — e.g. 'npm test && npm run lint'. Set by /tracker-init; build and ship stop if it's missing.

root.description: Backlog root relative to the repo, e.g. '.codemaster/backlog'. Gitignored in its entirety. Holds epics/, features/, and the ticket status folders (0-💡 backlog · 1-⬜ todo · 2-🟡 doing · 3-⛔ blocked · 4-✅ done).

idPrefix.description: Uppercase ticket id prefix, e.g. 'ETK' -> ETK-12. Not 'E' or 'F' (the epic and feature id letters).

plane.description: Settings for the `plane` provider (REST API via CLI).

envFile.description: Path (repo-relative) to the gitignored env file with PLANE_API_URL / PLANE_API_KEY / PLANE_WORKSPACE_SLUG.

statusMap.description: Maps CodeMaster status -> the provider's native state (for remote providers, a Plane state group). Identity for the folder provider.

blocked.description: Omit for the `plane` provider — Plane has no `blocked` state group; it models blocked as a label. /tracker-init --check flags it if present.
